text_block_list.text:
One day, after winning countless races 
together with Satono Diamond—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, haven't you been working a 
bit too hard lately?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No, quite the contrary. Please take a 
little rest. You are pushing yourself too 
hard.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Jeez...! You don't look alright at all!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's it! The hot springs!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You won tickets for a hot springs trip in 
the lottery, right! Let's go to the hot 
springs!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We promised we'd treat each other! So 
let's go! Pretty please? Come on!

Believing there was no time like the 
present, Satono Diamond called the inn to 
book a room right then and there... and 
before she knew it, she was standing 
before the ryokan.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm glad there was an available room!
choice_data_list: I was at the academy just a moment ago...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, we've stepped completely out of the 
everyday here! Let us forget all about 
work!

I'm worried about the work I left behind, 
but... Satono Diamond went out of her way 
for this. Since I'm here, I might as well 
fully enjoy my vacation.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's take it easy and relax.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Then let's hop into the hot spring right 
away and wash away our fatigue♪
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Phew, that was a wonderful bath.
choice_data_list:
Thanks to the hot spring, I feel so light 
and refreshed!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you really were tired after all, 
weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Would you like me to massage your 
shoulders?
choice_data_list: I've recovered my energy, so I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Well then... hmm...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I just couldn't think of a good way to 
show my appreciation...

I see. You promised to show your 
appreciation for each other, and you were 
agonizing over how to do it. You're quite 
conscientious.
choice_data_list:
In that case, want to go for a walk 
tomorrow?

In that case, want to go for a walk 
tomorrow?

text_block_list.text:
The brochure mentioned that there was a 
mountain stream behind the inn.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great! It feels like that'll be 
very refreshing!

Going down the stairs near the inn led to 
a mountain stream. The gentle murmuring of 
the flowing water was refreshing and 
pleasant.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It's cool and just the right temperature.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I wonder if there are any fish?

Filled with curiosity, Satono Diamond 
peers into the river and dips her hands 
into the water.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! Trainer! I can see a suspension 
bridge over there!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Let's go check it out!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... This looks like it's going to be 
quite a thrill...

With that said, Satono Diamond stepped 
onto the shaky suspension bridge.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Just for a moment... just a tiny bit. I'll 
just go for a second and come right back.

Before I could stop her, she lightly 
skipped across the suspension bridge. Then 
she came to a halt right around the 
middle.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Wah, what a wonderful view...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, it turned out pretty♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Look, Trainer. The view from the 
suspension bridge is wonderful.
choice_data_list:
You're right. But still, you're always 
doing such reckless things.

You're right. But still, you're always 
doing such reckless things.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... With you watching over me, 
Trainer, I just felt so at ease...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...When I was young, I crossed a 
suspension bridge with Kita-chan once 
too."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Back then, Kita-chan was in front of me, 
so just watching her back put me at ease.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...It might be similar to that. When 
you're with me, Trainer, I can feel at 
ease and just keep looking forward."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Just now, and during the race too...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...Not that it's any excuse for being 
reckless. I'll be careful from now on!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

"Because she is willing to take risks and 
dive into hardships, she can forge a 
brand-new chapter in history. If it truly 
gets out of hand, I just have to step in 
and stop her."

Straight ahead, true to her heart. I want 
her to run looking only forward.
Because that's who Satono Diamond is.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm so happy... Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Please continue to watch over Dia from now 
on as well.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Don't take your eyes off me, not even for 
a second♪

It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with Satono Diamond...
